core.title: Fleur De Lis Warwick Rough Black Iron Door Knocker, Acorn RMWBG

text.description_html:
Acorn RM4BG, Fleur-de-lis Iron Front Door Knocker

The Warwick Iron Door Knocker features a forged crest on the top and a swirled handle. Made famous by the French monarch Louis VII, the Fleur-de-lis shape that graces the top of this door knocker represents the strength and power. Acorn's RMWBG Warwick Rough Black Iron Door Knocker is a great way to add old-world elegance to your front door; and the royal history of the Fleur-de-lis only adds to the majesty of this knocker. It is easy to install with just a few screws. The uneven surface of rough iron duplicates that found on the ironwork of many European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Specifications of the Warwick Iron Door Knocker:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 8-1/4"
  • Width: 3-1/4"
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Surface Mounted with Included Screws
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
